description: Document an observed end-to-end process, handoffs and timing evidence.

provenance.author: LiNKskills Library
provenance.source: Pinned upstream modules copied with licenses and exact commit identities; see references/upstream/SOURCE-MANIFEST.json
provenance.license: See per-source upstream license copies and manifest

routing.when_to_use: Document an observed end-to-end process, handoffs and timing evidence.
when_not_to_use: A different task requires its own skill
exclusion_rules: Missing facts block the affected conclusion, not harmless drafting
ambiguity_rules: Read existing authorized evidence first; ask only material unanswered questions

required_inputs.name: task_inputs
required_inputs.description: trigger and finished outcome; actors, events and authorized records; sample population and observation window

expected_outputs.name: work_product
expected_outputs.description: as-is process map; handoff/RACI and exception table; timing/evidence gaps

forbidden_actions: Unapproved payments, filings, postings, signatures, purchases, external announcements or production changes
Inventing source facts, approval or canon
verification_steps: Define SIPOC boundaries, trigger, terminal result, unit of work, variant, process owner and observations. Observe actual execution before the workshop; prefer timestamps and artifacts over recalled durations.

Map the current path by responsible role/system in swimlanes, with inputs, outputs, decisions, queues, handoffs, re-keying, exceptions and rework return points. Validate it with people who perform the work; do not design the future path as if it were observed.

Measure touch time, wait time and rework separately from compatible samples. Report sample period/count and stage distributions, then compare the map against actual end-to-end cases. Never sum stage percentiles and call that an end-to-end percentile.

Inspect handoff density, owner changes, waiting share, system switches, duplicate entry, ping-pong and rework. Identify the constraint and causal uncertainty; source thresholds and Little Law apply only with their stated assumptions, not as universal company rules.

Prioritize remove, consolidate, parallelize and standardize before automation. Quantify labor savings from touch time only; monetize elapsed-time benefit only with owner-supported evidence. Record future-state proposals, dependencies, risks and acceptance measurements separately.
completion_criteria: Task output meets contract and task-specific acceptance criteria
Sources, uncertainty, exact completion scope and remaining decisions visible
Any authorized draft write read back
known_limitations: Structural qualification does not prove every behavior
Source originals are provenance; canonical method owns execution
Specialist content/draft access may be Sara-mediated

telemetry.retention_policy: retain opaque task/source ids and hashes only
